title: Completion-unit-normalized scalar comparison for pullback
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime, let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be a finite normed field extension, put $A=\mathcal O_E$ and fix a uniformizer $\varpi$. Let $k$ have positive prime characteristic different from $\ell$, and let all schemes mentioned be separated and of finite type over $k$. Require explicitly that each scheme is Noetherian and finite dimensional and that $\ell$ is invertible in its local rings. On the small pro-etale site put $A_T=\varprojlim_n(A/\varpi^n)_T$ and $E_T(V)=C(|V|,E)$, with pointwise operations; regard $E_T$ as an $A_T$-algebra through the canonical isomorphism $A_T\cong(V\mapsto C(|V|,A))$ of [lem-weil-pbc-continuous-coefficients-immersion-restriction] followed by postcomposition with the inclusion $A\subset E$. Use the integral category $\mathcal I_T=\Dbc(T,A)$ of [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete] and its raw scalar localization $\mathcal R_T=\mathcal I_T[1/\varpi]$ of [def-weil-pbc-rational-category]. Write $F_T=E_T\otimes^L_{A_T}-$ as in [lem-weil-pbc-realization-scalar-functor]. For any $k$-morphism $h:T\to U$ and $K\in\mathcal I_U$, the actual coefficient structure map $c_h:h^{-1}A_U\to A_T$ of [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback] is the canonical point-pullback isomorphism. Ordinary module pullback $P_hK=Lh_A^*K$ lies in $\mathcal I_T$. Its specified quotient-tower completion unit $\gamma_{h,K}:P_hK\to Lh^*_{\mathrm{comp}}K$ is an isomorphism. The natural comparison
$$\alpha_{h,K}:F_TLh^*_{\mathrm{comp}}K\xrightarrow{F_T(\gamma_{h,K}^{-1})}F_TP_hK\xrightarrow{\sim}Lh_c^*F_UK$$
uses the actual inverse-image/localization comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-localization-inverse-image-coherence]. It preserves localization units, sends pulled fractions to the pulled numerators with the same denominator, and respects identity and composition comparisons of pullback. These comparisons also induce those on the raw rationalized categories. No cartesian-square or properness hypothesis is needed.
